name: @sleepymug/fleet-pack
description: Trees of files as fleet moves them: as tar archives, written and read in one pass; a node package as installed, with what it depends on; and a tree's digest

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
